desc: Read the input values N, K, and the sequence A from standard input.
Generate all unique combinations of K indices from the range [0, N-1].
For each combination, compute the XOR sum of the corresponding elements in A.
Maintain and update the global maximum XOR value found during the iteration.
Print the maximum XOR value to standard output.
Implement the solution using Python's `itertools.combinations`, iterate through all combinations of size K, compute the XOR sum for each, track the maximum, and print the result.
Run the code against Sample Input 1 to verify output is 7.
Run the code against Sample Input 2 to verify output is 2024.
If both pass, mark as solved.
